name: ai-test-framework
description: AI Testing Platform for the Fidar server + CallCenterUI helpdesk portal

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='src/dashboard/public'; const dest='dist/src/dashboard/public'; fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.context: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js context
scripts.plan: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js plan
scripts.run-plan: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js run
scripts.all: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js all
scripts.dashboard: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js dashboard
scripts.server:start: npm run server:build && npm run db:migrate && node dist/server/index.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,blue "npm run server:start" "npm run web:dev"
